description:
Junior .NET Developer will be working in a high functioning agile development team responsible for the production of a state-of-the-art billing application for high-profile customers. Qualifications and requirements for the Junior .NET Developer are: 
 

 One (1) or more years of experience in C# development 
 One (1) or more years of experience with SQL 
 C#, ASP, Microsoft .NET Architecture framework, ASP.NET MVC, C# 
 Strong self-motivation and willingness to tackle challenging problems.

  C#, .NET, SQL Server

 Multiple Openings
